task: Review this survey response bar chart caption for accuracy against the supplied counts. One total does not match the sum of the supplied category counts. Identify the discrepancy.
input: Response counts by category: Strongly agree (42), Agree (30), Neutral (15), Disagree (8), Strongly disagree (4). Total responses: 100. The majority of respondents agreed or strongly agreed.

facts.text: Total responses: 99 (one response was excluded as invalid, reducing the total from 100 to 99).

forbidden_additions: Acceptance of total 100 when the supplied facts give 99.
An invented reason for the discrepancy beyond the supplied exclusion fact.
preserve: Individual category counts are accurate per facts.
Total discrepancy identified: 99 per facts, not 100.
The exclusion of one invalid response as the source of the discrepancy.
